players.product: York chillers for hyperscale data centers

quarterly_data.signal: Johnson Controls' fiscal third-quarter 2026 earnings release: Q3 sales increased 9% to $6.6 billion (net sales $6,614 million in the three months ended June 30, 2026 versus $6,052 million a year earlier). In the Americas segment, sales of $4.5 billion increased 11%, and backlog of $15.9 billion increased 40% year-over-year (excluding acquisitions and divestitures and adjusted for foreign currency); the release says the increase in orders and backlog was supported by sustained demand from data centers and other mission-critical environments.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 sales +9% to $6.6 billion ($6,614 million vs $6,052 million, three months ended June 30, 2026 vs 2025); Americas backlog $15.9 billion (+40% YoY, fiscal Q3 2026)
